cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): The fundamental, ineffable principle underlying the universe and all phenomena, often described as the source of all things and the ideal to be followed in life.
cards.Nuance (English): Implies a cosmic order that is beyond human comprehension and cannot be fully expressed in language.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The Dao that can be spoken of is not the eternal Dao; the name that can be named is not the eternal name;
cards.Sentences: S道可道，非常道，名可名，非常名；

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): To express verbally or in writing.
cards.Nuance (English): Often used in the context of communication or articulation, especially when referring to the act of conveying meaning.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): To speak, not by words. |To express one's will, not by rhetoric. |To convey what is known, not by writing. |To express the mind, not by form.
cards.Sentences: 道言，不以言也。|道其志，不以辞也。|道其所知，不以文也。|道其心，不以形也。
